title: Military aircraft with 32 people onboard crashes in southern Nigeria
summary: Rescue teams are searching the crash site after the military aircraft went down in southern Nigeria. The fate of those onboard remains unclear.

blocks.text: A military aircraft carrying 25 passengers and seven crew members crashed in southern Nigeria, authorities said on Monday.
There was no immediate word on whether there were casualties.
The aircraft was on a routine mission to Lagos, Nigeria's economic hub, when it crashed in the Igbokoda area of Ondo state, Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo said in a statement.
The Nigerian Air Force identified the aircraft as an ATR-42 and said an immediate search and rescue operation had been launched.
Keyamo said the aircraft disappeared from radar at around 9 a.m. local time and was later found to have crashed about halfway through its journey from Edo state to Lagos.
He said the wreckage had been located near a naval base.
A video circulating on social media showed a small crowd gathered near a river as rescuers searched the area by boat.
